How the studies were conducted.

Independent dermatologist evaluation commissioned by Caviar of Switzerland, conducted by a third-party CRO under blinded conditions where applicable. No internal assessments are used as primary data.

Chapter 04 · Clinical studies

Evidence you can read.

Every statistic we publish is backed by an independent dermatologist evaluation. Methodology, panel size, age range and duration are disclosed in full.

Each formula, studied on its own.

Separate studies by an independent contract research organisation. There is no study of the complete ritual, and the Micellar Water Cleanser has not been clinically studied.

  1. +47%

    Improved skin firmness

    Advanced Repair Serum

    Instrument‑measured · Cutometry (R2 parameter) · 32 women aged 45–60 · twice daily, 28 days

    Day 7 interim, same study: +22% surface smoothness (optical profilometry).

    Study detail

    Cutometry measurement of skin elasticity (R2 parameter) showed a statistically significant improvement in subjects using the Advanced Repair Serum twice daily for 28 days. All five High-Tech Complex actives contribute to this outcome through distinct but synergistic mechanisms, with the Syn®-Coll Peptide delivering the primary firming response.

    Profilometry at the Day 7 interim assessment showed measurable skin texture refinement, an early-response result attributed to the fast-penetrating Low-MW Hyaluronic Acid matrix and the immediate free-radical neutralisation from Superoxide Dismutase. The result increased to +38% by Day 28.

  2. −38%

    Reduction in crow’s‑feet depth

    Revitalizing Eye Cream

    Instrument‑measured · Optical profilometry · 30 women aged 42–65 · twice daily, 28 days

    Study detail

    Optical profilometry measured a 38% average reduction in lateral peri-orbital fine line depth in subjects using the Revitalizing Eye Cream. The Syn®-Coll Peptide and Caviar Extract combination showed the strongest dermal response in the periorbital zone, the thinnest and most delicate skin on the face. This result underpins our eye care for dark circles and skincare for fine lines and wrinkles.

  3. 100%

    Panellist satisfaction at 28 days

    24h Regeneration Cream

    Self‑reported · Tewametry + self-assessment · 34 women aged 40–65 · twice daily, 28 days

    Study detail

    Every panellist in the 24h Regeneration Cream study reported visible improvement in skin comfort, density and radiance at the 28-day assessment. Tewametry confirmed measurable improvement in barrier function across all subjects by Day 14, two weeks before the study’s final evaluation point. The same radiance result is the basis of our skincare for dull skin and lost radiance guidance.

How the studies were conducted.

Independent dermatologist evaluation commissioned by Caviar of Switzerland, conducted by a third-party CRO under blinded conditions where applicable. No internal assessments are used as primary data.

Female subjects aged 40–65, selected to represent the skin concern being measured: firmness, peri-orbital ageing or dehydration. Panel sizes n=28–34 per study. Methods: cutometry (elasticity), optical profilometry (wrinkle depth), tewametry (barrier function), dermatologist visual grading and validated subject self-assessment.

CHAPTER 05 · SWISS FORMULATION

Made in Zug, to a Swiss standard.

Every formula is subject to rigorous stability, safety and independent efficacy testing before it reaches your skin. This is what “Made in Switzerland” means in practice.

Switzerland is not a provenance claim. It is a formulation standard.

Swiss cosmetics are made under the Cosmetics Ordinance (SR 817.023.31), aligned to EU Regulation 1223/2009: documentation, safety and stability requirements that are enforced, not aspirational.

Caviar of Switzerland formulas are developed in a GMP-certified laboratory in Zug, at the centre of Switzerland’s life-sciences corridor. We formulate here not for the country’s association with luxury, but for what the standard demands of everyone who manufactures here.

Six stages before a formula is released.
01
Active selection

Each candidate active is assessed for bioavailability, evidence of mechanism and compatibility; actives that degrade one another are eliminated, regardless of marketing appeal.

02
Formulation

With the Zug laboratory’s cosmetic chemists, each formula is developed to one functional objective, and finalised only once it achieves its sensorial profile and passes preliminary stability checks.

03
Stability testing

Accelerated (40 °C / 75% RH), freeze-thaw and long-term storage over 24 months confirm that actives, pH, viscosity, colour and microbiological status stay within specification.

04
Safety assessment

A qualified safety assessor reviews each formula under Annex I of EU Regulation 1223/2009, ingredient by ingredient, at actual concentration.

05
Independent efficacy testing

Published results come from independent studies of single products by a third-party dermatology panel, never from in-house assessments or supplier data. See the studies.

06
GMP manufacturing & batch release

Each batch is made to written specification in the GMP-certified Zug facility, released only after quality control, and traceable from batch to jar.

You are not buying provenance. You are buying a process.

The four formulas are this process applied four times, to four distinct objectives, with the same five actives at concentrations calibrated for each.

text:
SWISS HERITAGE · CANTON OF ZUG

Precision born from the Alps.

Switzerland is not a backdrop. It is a methodology: four centuries of watchmaking mastery, pharmaceutical leadership and Alpine purity, distilled into every formula we create.

Experience the collection
Explore the science

Matterhorn, Valais · 4 478 m
Where one standard rules all others.

In Switzerland, precision is not a marketing claim. It is a cultural inheritance, threaded through four centuries of watchmaking mastery, pharmaceutical innovation and the enduring discipline of life in the Alps.

When we chose to formulate in Switzerland, we were not choosing a label. We were choosing to be held accountable. Every batch tested. Every ingredient traced. Every formula validated before it reaches your skin.

“In Switzerland, good enough has never been good enough.”

A heritage of doing things properly.

16th – 18th century

The age of the watchmaker

Swiss craftsmen in Geneva and Le Locle proved that the finest things demand the deepest patience. The mechanical watch, assembled by hand under magnification, made Swiss precision a practice, not a philosophy.

19th – 20th century

The pharmaceutical revolution

Basel became the pharmaceutical capital of the world, and the Canton of Zug emerged as its life sciences corridor. That infrastructure is our context.

21st century

Caviar of Switzerland

Founded here, in the Canton of Zug, as a direct heir to this tradition. Not inspired by Swiss heritage; constituted by it.

The Helvetic code.

Four concepts drawn from Swiss cultural tradition, applied to every decision we make.

Précision

Precision. Switzerland built the world’s most trusted timepieces by refusing approximation. We apply the same intolerance to formulation: exact concentrations, validated stability, documented efficacy.

Discrétion

Discretion. True luxury does not announce itself. No fragrance for its own sake, no theatrical textures. The results speak for themselves.

Maîtrise

Mastery. Our formulas draw on decades of ingredient science developed in Swiss laboratories. We do not follow trends. We follow data.

Durée

Endurance. Swiss watches are made to be passed to the next generation. Swiss skincare should work the same way: not a temporary sensation, but measurable, lasting improvement over time.

From raw ingredient to sealed vessel: manual verification at each stage, and a formula released only when it meets our quality standard.

Responsibility as a Swiss value.
Recyclable packaging, sustainable ingredient sourcing, and products built for longevity, not disposability.

title: Craftsmanship & Sourcing — Caviar of Switzerland
text:
CRAFTSMANSHIP & SOURCING · SWITZERLAND

Not a label. A standard.

Every formula is developed and manufactured at a certified Swiss laboratory in Zug. Every active ingredient is sourced with traceability requirements that meet or exceed the standards of pharmaceutical-grade cosmetic production.

Formulated in Zug, Switzerland. Manufactured to pharmaceutical standards.

Our formulation laboratory is in Zug, the canton synonymous with precision chemistry and advanced cosmetic science. It operates under ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification: the international standard for cosmetic production that governs cleanliness, documentation, quality control and batch traceability.

We manufacture in small batches. Each batch is tested for stability, microbial safety and active concentration before release; none leaves the facility without passing all parameters.

We do not outsource formulation to a contract manufacturer and apply a Swiss label after the fact. The intellectual property of the High-Tech Complex (its concentrations, its encapsulation technologies, the engineering that keeps five actives stable in a single formula) belongs to Caviar of Switzerland and is developed and protected in Zug.

CAVIAR EXTRACT SOURCING

Traceable from aquaculture to formula. No exceptions.

The caviar extract in the High-Tech Complex is derived from Acipenser baerii (Siberian) sturgeon, sourced exclusively from certified responsible aquaculture facilities. We do not use wild-caught sturgeon. We do not use species listed on the CITES endangered species register. Every batch is traceable to its source facility, its harvest date and its processing conditions.

Our aquaculture partners operate under the principle of regenerative farming: the roe is harvested after natural spawning without harm to the fish, in conditions that meet the highest animal welfare standards in the EU aquaculture certification framework. We audit these facilities annually.

Independent

Dermatologically tested. The clinical results published on this site come from independent studies with dermatologist evaluation, not internal studies. See the clinical studies.

text:
THE RITUAL

Four formulas.
One complete ritual.

Effective skincare is a sequence, not a single product. Each step prepares the skin for the next, morning and evening.

01

02

A single extraordinary product can transform a moment. A complete ritual can transform skin.

01

Step 1:
Cleanse

Micellar Water All‑in‑One Cleanser

Micelles lift away make-up, impurities and pollutants, while Aloe Vera, Tamarind Seed Extract and a Skin Barrier Optimizer preserve comfort and prepare the skin for Advanced Repair Serum. It cleanses, tones and refreshes in one step, without rinsing or residue.

AMOUNT
One soaked cotton pad
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
Soak a cotton pad with Micellar Water.
Sweep it gently across the face and neck in upward motions.
For eye make‑up, hold the pad over the closed eye for a few seconds, then wipe downwards and outwards. Do not rub.
No rinsing required. Follow immediately with Advanced Repair Serum.
WHO IT SUITS

Gentle for most skin types, including sensitive skin (if you have specific concerns, we recommend a patch test). For daily impurities, make‑up removal, dryness and tightness.

Step 2:
Treat

Advanced Repair Serum

The most concentrated formula of the ritual. Micro-encapsulated caviar extract and Syn®-Coll peptide support a firmer, smoother-looking complexion. Its silky, non-oily texture absorbs quickly, so the steps that follow layer without heaviness.

AMOUNT
Two to three drops
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
Apply to cleansed skin, after the Micellar Water.
Dispense two or three drops into the palm and press gently across face and neck.
Allow 60 seconds to absorb fully before the next step.
WHO IT SUITS

For fine lines and wrinkles, dullness, loss of firmness, environmental stress and dehydrated‑looking skin.

Step 3:
Revive

Revitalizing Eye Cream

Calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face. It melts on contact, helps diminish the appearance of dark circles and smooths the look of fine lines around the eyes, leaving the contour hydrated and softly replenished.

AMOUNT
A grain of rice per eye
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
Apply after the serum, before the cream.
Place a grain‑of‑rice amount on the ring finger, for each eye.
Pat gently along the orbital bone, from the inner to the outer corner. Never drag.
Compatible with SPF and make‑up: allow a moment to absorb first.
WHO IT SUITS

For an eye contour showing fine lines, dark circles, loss of firmness, dryness or visible fatigue.

Step 4:
Restore

24h Regeneration Cream

The final step seals the ritual. A silky, velvet-textured cream that locks in moisture and the serum and eye-care steps before it, with a caviar lipid complex that supports the skin’s barrier: lasting hydration and comfort, day and night.

AMOUNT
A pea‑sized amount
WHEN
Morning and evening
HOW TO APPLY
The final step, after serum and eye cream.
Warm a pea‑sized amount between the palms for three seconds.
Press it across face and neck to seal in the layers beneath.
By day, wear it under a broad‑spectrum SPF 50+. By night, it is your overnight treatment.

  1. Apply to cleansed skin, after the Micellar Water.

  1. +47%

    Improved skin firmness

    Advanced Repair Serum

    Instrument‑measured · Cutometry (R2 parameter) · 32 women aged 45–60 · twice daily, 28 days

    Day 7 interim, same study: +22% surface smoothness (optical profilometry).

    Study detail

    Cutometry measurement of skin elasticity (R2 parameter) showed a statistically significant improvement in subjects using the Advanced Repair Serum twice daily for 28 days. All five High-Tech Complex actives contribute to this outcome through distinct but synergistic mechanisms, with the Syn®-Coll Peptide delivering the primary firming response.

    Profilometry at the Day 7 interim assessment showed measurable skin texture refinement, an early-response result attributed to the fast-penetrating Low-MW Hyaluronic Acid matrix and the immediate free-radical neutralisation from Superoxide Dismutase. The result increased to +38% by Day 28.

  2. −38%

    Reduction in crow’s‑feet depth

    Revitalizing Eye Cream

    Instrument‑measured · Optical profilometry · 30 women aged 42–65 · twice daily, 28 days

    Study detail

    Optical profilometry measured a 38% average reduction in lateral peri-orbital fine line depth in subjects using the Revitalizing Eye Cream. The Syn®-Coll Peptide and Caviar Extract combination showed the strongest dermal response in the periorbital zone, the thinnest and most delicate skin on the face. This result underpins our eye care for dark circles and skincare for fine lines and wrinkles.

  3. 100%

    Panellist satisfaction at 28 days

    24h Regeneration Cream

    Self‑reported · Tewametry + self-assessment · 34 women aged 40–65 · twice daily, 28 days

    Study detail

    Every panellist in the 24h Regeneration Cream study reported visible improvement in skin comfort, density and radiance at the 28-day assessment. Tewametry confirmed measurable improvement in barrier function across all subjects by Day 14, two weeks before the study’s final evaluation point. The same radiance result is the basis of our skincare for dull skin and lost radiance guidance.

Chapter 05 of 05

Matterhorn, Valais. The formulas are made in Zug.

CHAPTER 05 · SWISS FORMULATION

Made in Zug, to a Swiss standard.

Every formula is subject to rigorous stability, safety and independent efficacy testing before it reaches your skin. This is what “Made in Switzerland” means in practice.

Switzerland is not a provenance claim. It is a formulation standard.

Swiss cosmetics are made under the Cosmetics Ordinance (SR 817.023.31), aligned to EU Regulation 1223/2009: documentation, safety and stability requirements that are enforced, not aspirational.

Caviar of Switzerland formulas are developed in a GMP-certified laboratory in Zug, at the centre of Switzerland’s life-sciences corridor. We formulate here not for the country’s association with luxury, but for what the standard demands of everyone who manufactures here.

Six stages before a formula is released.
01
Active selection

Each candidate active is assessed for bioavailability, evidence of mechanism and compatibility; actives that degrade one another are eliminated, regardless of marketing appeal.

02
Formulation

With the Zug laboratory’s cosmetic chemists, each formula is developed to one functional objective, and finalised only once it achieves its sensorial profile and passes preliminary stability checks.

03
Stability testing

Accelerated (40 °C / 75% RH), freeze-thaw and long-term storage over 24 months confirm that actives, pH, viscosity, colour and microbiological status stay within specification.

04
Safety assessment

A qualified safety assessor reviews each formula under Annex I of EU Regulation 1223/2009, ingredient by ingredient, at actual concentration.

05
Independent efficacy testing

Published results come from independent studies of single products by a third-party dermatology panel, never from in-house assessments or supplier data. See the studies.

06
GMP manufacturing & batch release

Each batch is made to written specification in the GMP-certified Zug facility, released only after quality control, and traceable from batch to jar.

You are not buying provenance. You are buying a process.

The four formulas are this process applied four times, to four distinct objectives, with the same five actives at concentrations calibrated for each.

SWISS HERITAGE · CANTON OF ZUG

Precision born from the Alps.

Switzerland is not a backdrop. It is a methodology: four centuries of watchmaking mastery, pharmaceutical leadership and Alpine purity, distilled into every formula we create.

Experience the collection
Explore the science

Matterhorn, Valais · 4 478 m
Where one standard rules all others.

In Switzerland, precision is not a marketing claim. It is a cultural inheritance, threaded through four centuries of watchmaking mastery, pharmaceutical innovation and the enduring discipline of life in the Alps.

When we chose to formulate in Switzerland, we were not choosing a label. We were choosing to be held accountable. Every batch tested. Every ingredient traced. Every formula validated before it reaches your skin.

“In Switzerland, good enough has never been good enough.”

A heritage of doing things properly.

16th – 18th century

The age of the watchmaker

Swiss craftsmen in Geneva and Le Locle proved that the finest things demand the deepest patience. The mechanical watch, assembled by hand under magnification, made Swiss precision a practice, not a philosophy.

19th – 20th century

The pharmaceutical revolution

Basel became the pharmaceutical capital of the world, and the Canton of Zug emerged as its life sciences corridor. That infrastructure is our context.

21st century

Caviar of Switzerland

Founded here, in the Canton of Zug, as a direct heir to this tradition. Not inspired by Swiss heritage; constituted by it.

The Helvetic code.

Four concepts drawn from Swiss cultural tradition, applied to every decision we make.

Précision

Precision. Switzerland built the world’s most trusted timepieces by refusing approximation. We apply the same intolerance to formulation: exact concentrations, validated stability, documented efficacy.

Discrétion

Discretion. True luxury does not announce itself. No fragrance for its own sake, no theatrical textures. The results speak for themselves.

Maîtrise

Mastery. Our formulas draw on decades of ingredient science developed in Swiss laboratories. We do not follow trends. We follow data.

Durée

Endurance. Swiss watches are made to be passed to the next generation. Swiss skincare should work the same way: not a temporary sensation, but measurable, lasting improvement over time.

title: Craftsmanship & Sourcing — Caviar of Switzerland
text:
CRAFTSMANSHIP & SOURCING · SWITZERLAND

Not a label. A standard.

Every formula is developed and manufactured at a certified Swiss laboratory in Zug. Every active ingredient is sourced with traceability requirements that meet or exceed the standards of pharmaceutical-grade cosmetic production.

Formulated in Zug, Switzerland. Manufactured to pharmaceutical standards.

Our formulation laboratory is in Zug, the canton synonymous with precision chemistry and advanced cosmetic science. It operates under ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification: the international standard for cosmetic production that governs cleanliness, documentation, quality control and batch traceability.

We manufacture in small batches. Each batch is tested for stability, microbial safety and active concentration before release; none leaves the facility without passing all parameters.

We do not outsource formulation to a contract manufacturer and apply a Swiss label after the fact. The intellectual property of the High-Tech Complex (its concentrations, its encapsulation technologies, the engineering that keeps five actives stable in a single formula) belongs to Caviar of Switzerland and is developed and protected in Zug.

CAVIAR EXTRACT SOURCING

Traceable from aquaculture to formula. No exceptions.

The caviar extract in the High-Tech Complex is derived from Acipenser baerii (Siberian) sturgeon, sourced exclusively from certified responsible aquaculture facilities. We do not use wild-caught sturgeon. We do not use species listed on the CITES endangered species register. Every batch is traceable to its source facility, its harvest date and its processing conditions.

Our aquaculture partners operate under the principle of regenerative farming: the roe is harvested after natural spawning without harm to the fish, in conditions that meet the highest animal welfare standards in the EU aquaculture certification framework. We audit these facilities annually.

Independent

Dermatologically tested. The clinical results published on this site come from independent studies with dermatologist evaluation, not internal studies. See the clinical studies.

The Ritual

Four formulas. One complete ritual.

Effective skincare is a sequence, not a single product. Each step prepares the skin for the next, morning and evening.

  1. 01Cleanse
  2. 02Treat
  3. 03Revive
  4. 04Restore

A single extraordinary product can transform a moment. A complete ritual can transform skin.

01

Step 1: Cleanse

Micellar Water All‑in‑One Cleanser

Micelles lift away make-up, impurities and pollutants, while Aloe Vera, Tamarind Seed Extract and a Skin Barrier Optimizer preserve comfort and prepare the skin for Advanced Repair Serum. It cleanses, tones and refreshes in one step, without rinsing or residue.

Amount
One soaked cotton pad
When
Morning and evening
How to apply
  1. Soak a cotton pad with Micellar Water.
  2. Sweep it gently across the face and neck in upward motions.
  3. For eye make‑up, hold the pad over the closed eye for a few seconds, then wipe downwards and outwards. Do not rub.
  4. No rinsing required. Follow immediately with Advanced Repair Serum.
Who it suits

Gentle for most skin types, including sensitive skin (if you have specific concerns, we recommend a patch test). For daily impurities, make‑up removal, dryness and tightness.

Discover the Micellar Water €55, · 150 ml

02

Step 2: Treat

Advanced Repair Serum

The most concentrated formula of the ritual. Micro-encapsulated caviar extract and Syn®-Coll peptide support a firmer, smoother-looking complexion. Its silky, non-oily texture absorbs quickly, so the steps that follow layer without heaviness.

Amount
Two to three drops
When
Morning and evening
How to apply
  1. Apply to cleansed skin, after the Micellar Water.
  2. Dispense two or three drops into the palm and press gently across face and neck.
  3. Allow 60 seconds to absorb fully before the next step.
Who it suits

For fine lines and wrinkles, dullness, loss of firmness, environmental stress and dehydrated‑looking skin.

Discover the Advanced Repair Serum €150, · 30 ml

03

Step 3: Revive

Revitalizing Eye Cream

Calibrated for the thinnest skin of the face. It melts on contact, helps diminish the appearance of dark circles and smooths the look of fine lines around the eyes, leaving the contour hydrated and softly replenished.

Amount
A grain of rice per eye
When
Morning and evening
How to apply
  1. Apply after the serum, before the cream.
  2. Place a grain‑of‑rice amount on the ring finger, for each eye.
  3. Pat gently along the orbital bone, from the inner to the outer corner. Never drag.
  4. Compatible with SPF and make‑up: allow a moment to absorb first.
Who it suits

For an eye contour showing fine lines, dark circles, loss of firmness, dryness or visible fatigue.

Discover the Revitalizing Eye Cream €145, · 15 ml

04

Step 4: Restore

24h Regeneration Cream

The final step seals the ritual. A silky, velvet-textured cream that locks in moisture and the serum and eye-care steps before it, with a caviar lipid complex that supports the skin’s barrier: lasting hydration and comfort, day and night.

Amount
A pea‑sized amount
When
Morning and evening
How to apply
  1. The final step, after serum and eye cream.
  2. Warm a pea‑sized amount between the palms for three seconds.
  3. Press it across face and neck to seal in the layers beneath.
  4. By day, wear it under a broad‑spectrum SPF 50+. By night, it is your overnight treatment.
Who it suits

For dryness, dehydration, fine lines and wrinkles, loss of elasticity and dullness.
